# Files that CI builds or runs but that are not in the package dependents
# fetch (build.zig.zon's `.paths`): a change to them is tested, and a push to
# main that only touches these and the files of no-ci.txt is tested but not
# released.
# One bash `case` glob per line, matched against the path from the repo
# root (`*` also matches `/`). Lines starting with # and blank lines are
# ignored.

# benchmarks, generators, rig and host tools, and the rigs' test programs
tools/*
test/*
# line endings at checkout, which the tests can see
.gitattributes
# CI's workflows, lists and scripts, and the release notes' sections
.github/*
